Grain Marketing Services
Partner with Top Ag to sell and store your grain. Whether you are looking for market analysis and forecasting, storage, or transportation, our team can help you make informed decisions that maximize your farm’s profit.
Contact Our Grain Department
Grain Hours
Monday – Friday:
8 a.m. – 4:30 p.m.*
*Please call for Harvest Hours
Our Storage Facilities
Trust us with your grain storage needs. With 9 grain facilities in Southwestern Illinois and over 12 million bushels of storage available, we are committed to helping our customers during the harvest months along with the off-the-farm grain movement to help maximize their grain marketing strategy. We continuously expand and upgrade our facilities to better serve you, adding more bin space and improving dumping speeds at all locations.
Are you looking for a convenient destination for your grain? Look no further than Top Ag! Simply pull into your closest facility, quickly dump your grain, and head back to the field for the next load.

Competitive Grain Bids and Contracting
Our market access allows us to offer grain bids at competitive rates. This includes river terminals and rail options from Addieville and Okawville locations to Southeast U.S. processors, end users, feed areas, and poultry areas. No matter your needs, our merchandisers will work with you on a pricing strategy you want to employ.
Top Ag Grain Marketing Contracts
Top Ag’s team of originators can work with you to determine a pricing strategy that suits your needs. We offer several contracting options, including:

Flat Price Contract
Straightforward with no minimum bushel amounts and no service fees. However, farmers who choose a Flat Price contract can lock in a price for grain to be delivered in a future month but cannot benefit if prices rise.

Basis Contract
When basis levels are strong, this contract allows you to lock in that strength and set your future price later.

Hedge-to-Arrive
This contract allows you to lock in the futures price while allowing the basis to be set at a later date. The basis must be set before the delivery of this contract.

Price Later
This contract allows the grain to be delivered without establishing any grain pricing. This contract will be subject to service fees depending on current market conditions. You are not allowed to forward contract the grain from Price Later.

Trucking Services
Are you in need of extra hauling capacity? Top Ag owns a fleet of trucks equipped to carry your grain and take it where it needs to go. Schedule a pickup at your farm bin or field.
About Our Fleet
With local drivers who know and understand farming, keep us in mind when you market your farm-stored grain and plan your agronomy inputs.
We also deliver fill products to stabilize Ag Bags. Contact our trucking team to learn how we can help with your transportation needs.
